command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/workspace/omega_runtime
CR=$R/carrier_repo
git -C $CR fetch -q origin omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain:omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain || git -C $CR fetch -q origin omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain
T=$(mktemp -d)
S=$(mktemp -d)
cleanup(){ if [ -n "${BPID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM $BPID 2>/dev/null || true; wait $BPID 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf $T $S; }
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir -p $T/omega
for f in grf_emergence.py brain_runtime.py grf_optimizer.py; do git -C $CR show omega-vps-deploy-grfbrain:omega_deploy/grfbrain-78fde13/omega/$f > $T/omega/$f; done
touch $T/omega/__init__.py
PYTHONPATH=$T python3 -m py_compile $T/omega/*.py
PYTHONPATH=$T python3 - <<'PY' > $S/math.json
import json
from omega.grf_emergence import GRFEmergenceField,GRFParameters,normalized_effective_information
from omega.grf_optimizer import GRFRegimeOptimizer,score_candidate
a=GRFEmergenceField(seed=42,params=GRFParameters(units=256,groups=8,fanout=4)); b=GRFEmergenceField(seed=42,params=GRFParameters(units=256,groups=8,fanout=4))
for _ in range(160): a.step('same'); b.step('same')
a.perturbation_probe('same'); b.perturbation_probe('same')
deterministic_replay=(a.snapshot()['macrostate']==b.snapshot()['macrostate'] and a.snapshot()['metrics']==b.snapshot()['metrics'])
ei_det=normalized_effective_information({0:{1:20},1:{0:20}}); ei_deg=normalized_effective_information({0:{0:20},1:{0:20}})
base=score_candidate(a,a.params,'same',horizon=5); before=a.snapshot()['parameters']; opt=GRFRegimeOptimizer(horizon=5,min_improvement=0.005).optimize(a,'same'); after=a.snapshot()['parameters']; m=a.metrics().as_dict()
print(json.dumps({'deterministic_replay':deterministic_replay,'ei_det':ei_det,'ei_deg':ei_deg,'ei_sanity':ei_det>ei_deg,'metrics':m,'shadow':{'action':opt.action,'accepted':opt.accepted,'baseline':opt.baseline.score,'selected':opt.selected.score,'before':before,'after':after}},sort_keys=True))
PY
mkdir -p $S/runtime
PYTHONPATH=$T OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=$S/runtime python3 -m omega.brain_runtime --runtime-root $S/runtime --target-cpu 0.20 --hard-ceiling 0.24 --units 768 --groups 16 --fanout 6 --batch-steps 8 --probe-steps 96 --emit-seconds 9999 >$S/brain.log 2>&1 &
BPID=$!
sleep 3
python3 - <<PY > $S/cpu_start.json
import json,time,os
pid=$BPID
stat=open(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read().split(); hz=os.sysconf(os.sysconf_names['SC_CLK_TCK'])
print(json.dumps({'t':time.monotonic(),'ticks':int(stat[13])+int(stat[14]),'hz':hz,'cpu_count':os.cpu_count()}))
PY
sleep 24
python3 - <<PY > $S/cpu_end.json
import json,time,os
pid=$BPID
stat=open(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read().split(); hz=os.sysconf(os.sysconf_names['SC_CLK_TCK'])
print(json.dumps({'t':time.monotonic(),'ticks':int(stat[13])+int(stat[14]),'hz':hz,'cpu_count':os.cpu_count()}))
PY
kill -TERM $BPID; wait $BPID || true; BPID=
python3 - <<PY
import json,pathlib,hashlib
s=pathlib.Path('$S'); a=json.loads((s/'cpu_start.json').read_text()); b=json.loads((s/'cpu_end.json').read_text()); dt=b['t']-a['t']; cpu_s=(b['ticks']-a['ticks'])/a['hz']; core_fraction=cpu_s/dt; host_fraction=core_fraction/a['cpu_count']; mathr=json.loads((s/'math.json').read_text()); status=json.loads((s/'runtime/brain/STATUS.json').read_text()); files={}
for f in ['grf_emergence.py','brain_runtime.py','grf_optimizer.py']:
 p=pathlib.Path('$T/omega')/f; files[f]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out={'result':'PASS' if mathr['deterministic_replay'] and mathr['ei_sanity'] and 0.14<=host_fraction<=0.24 else 'FAIL','math':mathr,'cpu':{'window_seconds':dt,'cpu_seconds':cpu_s,'process_core_fraction':core_fraction,'host_fraction':host_fraction,'target':0.20,'hard_ceiling':0.24},'runtime_status':status,'carrier_file_sha256':files,'production_state_touched':False}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
if out['result']!='PASS': raise SystemExit(41)
PY
